_comments: directoryOrder is a DEPENDENCY order, not a preference. It previously listed only 'schema-info',
which meant every other folder pushed in filesystem order — and got away with it because v1's
seeds had no cross-folder references. v2's do.
The order below, and why each step is where it is:
schema-info             — the schema registration everything else resolves against
entities                — the layered-view flags and form chrome. FIRST among the entity-shaped
folders, because the flags must be set before any codegen regenerates
the base view (see .entities.json for the trap this avoids)
contract-templates      — @lookup: a template type by name (item 4)
entity-relationships    — LAST. Both the collection declarations and the form chrome key off
@lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships rows, which CodeGen mints when it
registers the entities — so these can only resolve once every entity
on both sides of every relationship exists.
applications            — the nav row; independent, but conventionally last (orders does the same)
